beats.text: Five Stoic truths about the time you keep letting slip away.
One. Life isn't short, said Seneca. We just waste most of it, then complain it was brief.
Two. You guard your money and your door — yet give your hours away to anyone who asks.
Three. Putting things off is the biggest waste of life. It robs you of today for a tomorrow that may not come.
Four. You act immortal. You plan decades ahead while squandering the single hour you actually hold.
Five. The time you've lost to distraction isn't coming back. But the next hour is still yours.
It is not that we have too little time, said Seneca. It is that we waste so much of it.
